name: Ordering reduces stock by the ordered quantity
description: Checkout rules: what may and may not become an order (empty cart, reuse, out of stock, billing address, guest), stock, payment methods and invoice line prices.
descriptionHtml: Checkout rules: what may and may not become an order (empty cart, reuse, out of stock, billing address, guest), stock, payment methods and invoice line prices.
statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: ordering does not reduce stock; admin stock stays the same after a 201 order, e.g. Hammer 24 -> 24 after 3 units (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: stock of Slip Joint Pliers must drop by at least the 1 ordered, else we oversell: 24 -> 24
assert 24 <= (24 - 1)
statusTrace:
customer_api = <toolshop.api.client.ToolshopApi object at 0x7d35fec7c050>
admin_api = <toolshop.api.client.ToolshopApi object at 0x7d35feedec90>

    @pytest.mark.progression
    @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="BUG: ordering does not reduce stock; admin stock stays the same after a "
                                           "201 order, e.g. Hammer 24 -> 24 after 3 units (found 2026-11-10)")
    def test_ordering_reduces_stock_by_the_ordered_quantity(customer_api, admin_api, filled_cart):
        cart_id, product, quantity = filled_cart
        before = admin_api.stock_level(product["id"])
    
        r = customer_api.place_order(cart_id)
    
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"Setup: order failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
        after = admin_api.stock_level(product["id"])
        # "<=": other shoppers on the shared site may buy the same product meanwhile
>       assert after <= before - quantity, \
            f"stock of {product['name']} must drop by at least the {quantity} ordered, else we oversell: {before} -> {after}"
E       AssertionError: stock of Slip Joint Pliers must drop by at least the 1 ordered, else we oversell: 24 -> 24
E       assert 24 <= (24 - 1)
